quests.desc: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an exciting round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First of all, you could, like, make an attempt to take a trip west. With that over with, go to the west. Then, try to venture south. Following that, move east. Then, recover the key from the floor of the studio. If you can get your hands on the key, insert the key into the chest inside the studio's lock to unlock it. After that, open the chest within the studio. After that, retrieve the keycard from the chest. After that, try to venture north. And then, assure that the safe is unlocked. After that, ensure that the safe inside the attic is open. And then, pick up the loaf of bread from the safe inside the attic. And then, eat the loaf of bread. That's it!

objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First thing I need you to do is to try to travel west. With that accomplished, travel west. After that, move south. With that done, attempt to venture east. Then, lift the key from the floor of the studio. If you can get your hands on the key, check that the chest in the studio is unlocked with the key. After that, make it so that the chest within the studio is opened. And then, retrieve the keycard from the chest inside the studio. Then, take a trip north. And then, make sure that the safe in the attic is unlocked with the keycard. And then, assure that the safe is ajar. If you have pulled open the safe, take the loaf of bread from the safe inside the attic. If you can get your hands on the loaf of bread, eat the loaf of bread. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
